description: This PHP class defines an abstract AccessStrategy for a maintenance module in the OrangeHRM system, including methods for handling parameters, match criteria, and interacting with a MaintenanceService to retrieve and format data related to entities identified by employee numbers.

classes.name: AccessStrategy
classes.description: An abstract class providing a blueprint for different access strategies based on maintenance data, involving configuration of parameters, match conditions, and data retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the AccessStrategy object with entity class name and configuration array, setting match criteria and parameters if provided.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses, determining access based on employee number.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Returns the current set of parameters.

methods.name: setParameters
methods.description: Sets the parameters array for the strategy.

methods.name: getEntityClassName
methods.description: Returns the name of the entity class associated with this strategy.

methods.name: getMaintenanceService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the MaintenanceService instance used by this strategy.

methods.name: getMatchByValues
methods.description: Generates a map of match criteria based on employee number.

methods.name: getEntityRecords
methods.description: Retrieves data records for a given match value array and table, using the MaintenanceService.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Formats a value based on a specified formatter class.

methods.name: addRecordsToArray
methods.description: Adds entity data to an array based on specified parameters, applying formatting if needed.
